english.title: Supervisor fail to prepare and sign load sheet and submit to pilot for examination
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person supervising the loading of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..) for a public transport flight, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT..), failed

(A)_[,before the commencement of the flight, to prepare and sign a load sheet in duplicate conforming to the prescribed requirements]_
(B)_[to submit the load sheet for examination by the pilot in command of the aircraft]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 124(1) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
